_note: Trophy display + plaque engraving (task 5.1). One shared art base per trophy; the plaque is engraved at view time from a ledger row (data/Trophies_Historic.csv + data/Trophies_Season.csv). No image file is ever stored per trophy won. New art = drop the PNG in assets/trophies/ and add/point one 'events' entry here.

plaque._note: Default engraving box in SOURCE pixels of the art (size x size). The shared base is 1200x1200 with a blank #CFD4D8 plaque at x 280-919, y 914-1073. text_color = engraving ink. max_lines is fixed at 2 (team, then '<year> <event>'). padding = share of the box width kept clear on each side. line1_max/line2_max = largest font size as a share of the box height (auto-fit only shrinks from there). uppercase_line2 matches the Dwight Fight's engraved look.

overrides._note: Per-art geometry/colour, keyed by the art path. Any 'plaque' key can be overridden. Dwight Fight: its own art (1254 px, its own plaque) and brown ink, kept exactly as the page drew it before (left 24.6%, top 82.5%, width 50.6%, height 11.1%, #4a260d, 10px of a ~33px plaque per line).

events._note: EventType -> art, engraving and fallback logo. Placeholders: {year} {conference} {event} (the bowl, aliased by bowl_art for art and bowl_labels for text) {round} {team}. art/logo are repo paths. line2 = plaque line 2; alt = the trophy's alt text. A missing art file shows the fallback block (logo + the same two lines), never a broken image.

CCG._note: Conference championship game winner. {conference} = league short name (data/LeagueShortNames.csv).
CCG.name: {conference} Championship

PlayoffRound._note: Elite 8 / Final Four winners, on that year's host playoff bowl (the round is on line 2 because each playoff bowl hosts different rounds by year). Seasons whose playoff had no host bowls (2021) get no round trophy.
PlayoffRound.name: {event}

NIT._note: NIT champion (the final is the Stagg Bowl).
NIT.name: NIT Championship

Guillotine._note: The Guillotine champion (co-champions each get a row).
Guillotine.name: The Guillotine

DwightFight._note: Dwight Fight champion; geometry from overrides.
DwightFight.name: Dwight Fight

bowl_art._note: Bowl played under an older or sponsored name -> the art file of the same bowl today. config/league.json postseason.bowls.history_names is merged in automatically (Brooklyn -> Gotham etc.); add a line here only for names it doesn't cover. Unlisted names without art use the fallback.

bowl_labels._note: Bowl name to ENGRAVE when the season's name was a sponsor's (no-sponsor rule). Everything else is engraved as played. Open question for Chris: Belk, Duke's Mayonnaise, Outback, EA Sports, FedEx, Geico, Ice, PlayStation, Xbox (see PR_README).

display._note: Card widths in CSS px (they shrink on narrow screens). list = bowl/CCG/NIT/playoff-round cards; champion = bracket champion card and Special Events champions; export = the champion card's Save image.
